recommendation.purpose: Provider calls and research result validation
recommendation.quality: Useful bounded logic; adaptation and new verification required
recommendation.reason: Port deadline/abort, endpoint allowlist, safe error codes and strict probability checks. Replace roles, prompts and result envelopes; require a bounded stream reader. Do not port research() wholesale.
recommendation.risks: readJson fallback response.text reads unbounded before checking size. TypeClient forces missing=[] and omits provider request identity. Local correlation must not masquerade as remote request ID. Remote availability not verified
